assumptions.message: Peaks near supports, reentrant corners or idealized load/bond edges may increase with refinement. No automatic singularity detection is claimed. Compare fixed physical locations away from these regions; a lower smoothed peak is not evidence of convergence or a design allowable.

Compare raw integration-point von Mises with the frozen supplied ductile yield. Yield exceedance does not model plastic deformation; missing yield cannot establish a factor. No fatigue, brittle failure, buckling or code check is implied.

Maximum native displacement / largest body extent is a 1% screening heuristic. Exceedance requires review of small-deformation linear elasticity. Passing this heuristic does not bound local strain/rotation or certify validity; display exaggeration is irrelevant.

figures.caption: Frozen loads and supports on undeformed geometry. Arrows indicate global direction only; squares indicate fixed supports. Marker numbers resolve to the setup table; arrow lengths do not encode magnitude.

Stress σxx; global Cartesian; element-node boundary; Equal-weight arithmetic mean of incident element-node tensors at the same mesh node, partitioned by body and material; all incident volume elements contribute once. Invariants are calculated after tensor averaging. No spatial merging or FRD stress. Display derivative only; smoothing can hide element jumps and is not convergence evidence.. Deformation ×50; visible bodies 6f33a3928358ca77193419343abe0d6296faa1302201ba2451e64ad24f8716ef:b1. Flat triangle colour samples use the vertex-scalar mean; no numerical extrema are read from pixels. Camera and SI limits are retained in the report model.

Passing equilibrium does not establish convergence, stability or physical validity. Target-laptop validation and remaining external references are pending; bounded M3 approval does not certify this design.
Figures are light report derivatives of retained verified data. Hidden bodies, clipping, smoothing and deformation do not alter all-body native extrema or warnings.
